supportingSources.label: Kineticist Kick Off and Quarterback machine guide
New York Pinball Kick Off flyer index

strategy.summary: Plunge a lit top lane, advance the ball through the safest field-progress shot, collect the 5,000-point goal, and protect the built bonus with controlled upper play.

quickInfo.name: Lit-lane plunge
quickInfo.summary: The two lit top lanes alternate as switch hits register, so aim for one lit lane on every plunge.

quickInfo.name: Field progress
quickInfo.summary: The left spinner, right drop targets, and upper-right route advance the ball downfield.

quickInfo.name: Goal value
quickInfo.summary: Completing the field scores a 5,000-point goal before any enabled replay or extra-ball award.

quickInfo.name: Base bonus
quickInfo.summary: One bonus advance is awarded for each 20 yards of field progress, up to 15,000.

quickInfo.name: Staggered flippers
quickInfo.summary: The paired upper and lower flippers favor continuous shots and make long cradles difficult.

steps.text: Plunge one of the two lit top lanes.
Watch the first upper-playfield exit and learn which flipper receives the ball.
Test the left spinner when its entry and return are controlled.
Use the spinner as the main field-progress shot while it continues to return safely.
Use the upper-right route when the spinner entry is poor.
Shoot the right drop bank only after you have seen a safe rebound from it.
Complete the field and collect the 5,000-point goal.
Repeat the safest progress route and protect the built bonus until the ball ends.

fallback.title: Recovery: Upper-right field progress
fallback.when: Recovery pivot: Use this plan when the spinner rejects shots or the right drop bank returns the ball out of control.

steps.text: Stop shooting the unsafe spinner or drop bank.
Send the ball toward the upper-right field-progress route.
Hold the receiving upper flipper only when that improves the rebound from its rubbered post.
Let upper-playfield action add field and bonus progress.
Resume the spinner only after its feed becomes reliable.

alternatives.title: Position play: Controlled drop-bank finish
alternatives.when: When trailing, use this distinct scoreboard route: use this plan when only a small amount of field progress remains and the right-bank rebound is predictable.

steps.text: Wait for a clean lower-flipper angle to the needed drop target.
Shoot only the target that advances the field.
Prepare the opposite flipper for the rebound.
Stop direct target play after the goal is complete or the rebound becomes unsafe.

alternatives.title: Final-ball bonus play
alternatives.when: Use this plan on a ball that automatically doubles bonus under the installed edition and settings.

steps.text: Confirm the bonus-double schedule on the instruction card.
Shoot the left spinner, right drop targets, or top lanes to move the field in 20-yard steps.
Favor the safest upper route after the base bonus is high.
Do not risk a dangerous target only to finish another goal.
Use the left spinner, right drop targets, or top lanes, choosing the route with the safest return, to advance the field.
Add one bonus step for each 20 yards.
Complete the field for a 5,000-point goal.
Repeat the field-progress shots; each 20 yards adds 1,000 base bonus, up to 15,000.
Preserve the bonus through controlled upper play.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Kick Off or Quarterback and read the ball-count and automatic Double Bonus schedule on the instruction card.
Check whether replay, Extra Ball, and Special awards remain enabled or score points in tournament play.
Test spinner strength, drop-bank rebounds, bumper exits, staggered-flipper feeds, tilt sensitivity, and switch registration before choosing a repeat shot.

techniques.name: Alternating-lane plunge
techniques.instruction: Read the two lit top lanes before the plunge and change plunge strength or aim to enter either lit lane.

techniques.name: Cradle
techniques.instruction: Track the ball across the staggered flipper pair and shoot the left spinner without waiting for a full cradle.

techniques.name: Upper-flipper post return
techniques.instruction: When the ball reaches the rubbered post below an upper outlane, test whether holding the nearby upper flipper guides the rebound toward a lower flipper.

cautions.issue: A ball that approaches a raised lower flipper can roll up its edge and reach the outlane.
cautions.response: Do not hold the lower flipper without a clear reason. Release it before a slow ball reaches its outside edge.

cautions.issue: The upper bumpers produce many of the common center drains.
cautions.response: Keep both lower flippers ready until the full bumper exit is clear, and stop nudging after the ball has entered a lower lane.

cautions.issue: Direct shots at the right drop bank can return sharply toward the center or an outlane.
cautions.response: Test one controlled target shot, then replace the bank with spinner or upper-right progress if the rebound is unsafe.

strategy.simpleOverview: Kick Off / Quarterback advances a ball downfield through the left spinner, right drop targets, and upper-right route. Plunge a lit top lane, repeat the safest progress shot until the field is complete, collect the 5,000-point goal, and preserve the bonus earned for every 20 yards.
strategy.overview: Kick Off / Quarterback advances a ball downfield through the left spinner, right drop targets, and upper-right route. Use a lit top-lane plunge, learn the staggered-flipper return, and favor the left spinner or upper-right route over the drop bank until its rebound is known. Complete the field for 5,000, then repeat the same controlled route while protecting the built bonus.
machineSetup: Confirm Kick Off or Quarterback and read the ball-count and automatic Double Bonus schedule on the instruction card.
Check whether replay, Extra Ball, and Special awards remain enabled or score points in tournament play.
Test spinner strength, drop-bank rebounds, bumper exits, staggered-flipper feeds, tilt sensitivity, and switch registration before choosing a repeat shot.
